body:
This may very well be an outright duplicate of #111625, but since there was no MRP there I can't say for sure. Given that the description there mentions that the renaming "will not update the value of exported variable", I suspect that particular case is a `NodePath` export, which does indeed just leave you with a stale value. With class/node references, like what's seen here, it instead seems to just silently remove the references altogether, which seems much worse in my opinion.

(I'm also not entirely sure if this warrants being `topic:core` or `topic:editor` or both. I figured there were parallels to #110518, as mentioned in #111625, which might warrant the former, but feel free to change it.)
